scope: Read-only, in-memory scan of two already-running XChat GTK2 windows after the R584 palette reload; compare exact installed normal/focused 15x15 scrollbar stepper cells without retaining conversation pixels.

method.capture: XGetWindow image via xwd, converted in a pipe and scanned in memory
method.comparison: Exact RGB match of installed 15x15 stepper assets; directions and all five GTK2 states searched.

result: The live XChat process renders exact current GTK2 assets for the observed up/down vertical steppers and one horizontal right stepper. This confirms the R584 native reload reached existing GTK2 windows without restarting them.
limits: No left-stepper cell was found in these two windows; this is not evidence of a rendering mismatch because the target cell/state may not be present in either capture.
This is normal/focused pixel identity only; it does not prove the user's full visual acceptance or any pressed VUE state.
No conversation content was read or retained.
next: Continue I167 in GTK2 only. Keep the horizontal-left/pressed VUE state pending Q505; do not repeat normal-cell scans already covered by R580/R584/R585.
